definitions.explanation: The polite/honorific form of {確認|かくにん}, used in business correspondence, customer service, and formal requests to ask someone to check or confirm something.

examples.japanese: ご{確認|かくにん}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{確認|かくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧。
examples.english: I would appreciate your confirmation of the contents.

examples.japanese: ご{確認|かくにん}⟦いただけました→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Have you had a chance to check?

examples.japanese: ⟦{添付|てんぷ}ファイル→添付ファイル：24475_tenpufairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご{確認|かくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧、ご⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please review the attached file and reply.

notes:
The honorific form of ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (confirmation), created by adding the prefix ご. One of the most frequently used polite expressions in Japanese business email. Nearly every business email in Japan includes ご{確認|かくにん} in some form.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ご{確認|かくにん}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please check (standard polite)
- ご{確認|かくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほど⟦お{願|ねが}いいたします→お願いいたします：27603_onegaiitashimasu⟧: I kindly request your confirmation (very polite)
- ご{確認|かくにん}⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: could you please check? (polite request)
- ご{確認|かくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: after checking; upon confirmation
- ご{確認|かくにん}⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧: thank you for confirming

BUSINESS EMAIL CONTEXT:
Used when sending documents, proposals, schedules, or any information that requires the recipient's review. Part of the standard set of ご + noun expressions in business Japanese.

OTHER COMMON ご + NOUN PATTERNS IN BUSINESS EMAIL:
- ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: contact/communication
- ご⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧: consideration
- ご⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧: reply
- ご⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: report
